recovery.name: Recovery & Performance
recovery.tagline: Regeneration and resilience for athletes and demanding training.
recovery.hook: You train at the limit and want to recover faster, protect your joints, and return stronger to every session.
recovery.body: Designed to support your body's own tissue repair. It aims to support the regeneration of muscle, tendon, and ligament, encourage collagen production, and optimize the cellular environment where recovery happens, with a calming, anti-inflammatory intent. The goal: less discomfort, better recovery between sessions, and a structure more resilient to strain.
benefits: Faster muscle recovery after effort or strain
Support for tendons, ligaments, and connective tissue
Encourages collagen production and tissue regeneration
Support for digestive and immune wellness
recovery.idealFor: Athletes, CrossFit and HYROX, strength and endurance sports, recovery after strain or overload.
recovery.schema: Daily application with alternating-day reinforcement. Recommended cycle: 3 months.

metabolic.name: Metabolic Reset
metabolic.tagline: Sustainable fat loss with medical guidance and nutritional accompaniment.
metabolic.hook: You have tried diets and discipline. You want to reduce fat with medical guidance and keep the result.
metabolic.body: Works on body composition on two fronts: supporting appetite regulation and satiety while supporting healthy energy metabolism at the cellular level. The intent is a sustainable approach to fat reduction, more energy, and improved metabolic efficiency, always personalized and supervised.
metabolic.idealFor: People seeking real, sustainable fat loss with medical backing, beyond traditional restriction.
metabolic.schema: One weekly application plus daily support. Recommended cycle: 3 months. Includes nutritional accompaniment.

longevity.name: Longevity Premium
longevity.tagline: Energy, skin, sleep, and cellular vitality for the years ahead.
longevity.hook: You want to slow the clock: more energy, better skin, deeper sleep, and vitality you feel inside and out.
longevity.body: An integrated longevity program with intent on three levels: supporting skin quality through collagen and elastin, supporting cellular energy and mental clarity, and supporting endocrine balance and sleep cycles. A considered, cell-level approach to healthy aging.
longevity.idealFor: Those seeking a complete approach to longevity and rejuvenation.
longevity.schema: Daily application with alternating-day reinforcement. Recommended cycle: 3 months.

executive.name: Executive Performance
executive.tagline: Calm, focus, and recovery for high-pressure lives.
executive.hook: You live under pressure and want to perform at your best: focus, calm, better sleep, and high-level recovery.
executive.body: Designed for the high-performing executive. It aims to support deep sleep quality, recovery, and body composition, while supporting a calmer stress response without sedation, favoring focus, memory, and emotional steadiness. Calm and performance, together.
benefits: Supports a calmer stress response without sedation

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
RegenerAxis ("we", "us") respects your privacy and protects the personal data you share with us. This policy explains what we collect, why, and the rights you have over your information.

Information we collect

We collect only the data you provide voluntarily through our contact and booking forms and through WhatsApp: your name, country or city, program of interest, and the contents of your message. When you book a paid assessment, scheduling and payment are handled by our booking and payment providers, who process your data under their own terms.

How we use it

We use your data to respond to your enquiries, complete an eligibility check, coordinate your medical assessment, and provide the care you request. We do not sell your personal data, and we do not share it with third parties for advertising.

Service providers

We rely on trusted providers for scheduling, payment processing, hosting, and basic, privacy-respecting traffic analytics. These providers only receive the data needed to perform their function.

Data retention

We keep your data only as long as needed to attend to your request and to meet our legal and accounting obligations, after which it is deleted or anonymized.

Your rights

Under Colombian data-protection law (Ley 1581 de 2012, Habeas Data), you may request access to, correction, updating, or deletion of your personal data, and you may withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us through the contact page or via WhatsApp.
